title: きゅうきゅうびょういん (Kyuukyuu Byouin)
description: A young nurse's first night shift at the emergency room. One after another, patients arrive — a child with a sprained ankle, an elderly man who fell, a worker with a wrist injury. Between emergencies, she reflects on why she chose 医学 and what it means to truly help someone.
author: オリジナル
